=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text tk "K  "
text tc "C  "
text tf "F  "
text tr "R  "
text minus "-"
text dot "."
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emitc2 writes v hundredths (signed) as a decimal with two places
fn emitc2 v long to void
u = ulong 0
if lt v 0
emit minus
u = ulong neg v
else
u = ulong v
end
emitu div u 100
emit dot
f = rem u 100
if lt f 10
emitu 0
end
emitu f
end
note k is kelvin in hundredths, a multiple of 5 so every scale below is exact in hundredths:
note C = K - 273.15, F = K * 9/5 - 459.67, R = K * 9/5
fn show k long to void
emit tk
emitc2 k
emit nl
emit tc
emitc2 sub k 27315
emit nl
emit tf
emitc2 sub div mul k 9 5 45967
emit nl
emit tr
emitc2 div mul k 9 5
emit nl
emit nl
end
fn main to int
show 2100
show 0
show 27315
show 37315
show 31015
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
